t: r/ClickAndGrow on Reddit: New to Click & Grow: Are the pods absolutely necessary or can I use my own soil and seeds?
s: October 27, 2021 - The Click & Grow system is little more than a specifically shaped tub of water with pot holders, some wicking material to keep their proprietary compost pods moist, and a full-spectrum · LED lamp on a timer. There's nothing particularly innovative other than the proprietary compost/fertiliser blend they use in their pods. Using your own compost/fertiliser mix is absolutely possible if you so wish. I'll note that the main reason to buy in to this system is the convenience; there are similarities in the business model with single-serve coffee pods - €9.95 for three pods of compost and a few seeds is not cost effective when you compare it to buying seeds and compost in more traditional quantities, but it's undeniably convenient.
